trust.lightingBrief: Mid-morning natural light, clear blue sky, warm and clean tones. Crew actively working on a pitched roof of a suburban US home. Light comes from the upper left. Shadows are short and soft. Colors are saturated but realistic. The overall feel is competent, professional, and safe.
trust.skyDescriptor: Clear blue sky with light high clouds. No drama, no weather threat. Clean and open.
trust.shadowDescriptor: Short, soft shadows indicating mid-morning sun. Nothing harsh or theatrical.

emergency.lightingBrief: Dusk or overcast dramatic sky, slightly cooler tones with urgency in the light. A crew working quickly on a damaged roof, visible tarping or damaged shingles in foreground. The scene communicates speed and response, not chaos. Enough light to read faces and tools.
emergency.skyDescriptor: Overcast or early dusk sky. Clouds with movement and texture. Not nighttime but definitely late in the day or post-storm.
emergency.shadowDescriptor: Diffuse shadows from overcast light. No direct sun. Slightly moody but not dark.

completion.lightingBrief: Golden hour light from the late afternoon, warm golden tones. A finished roof in excellent condition is the primary subject. A homeowner or homeowners stand in front of their home, visibly pleased. The crew may be visible in the background packing up. The scene communicates a job done right.
completion.skyDescriptor: Golden hour sky, warm orange and yellow tones on the horizon, deep blue above. A few high clouds catching the warmth.
completion.shadowDescriptor: Long warm shadows from low-angle golden hour sun. Everything glows slightly.

golden_hour_warm.lightingBrief: Warm directional light from a low angle, long soft shadows, saturated golden tones. Crew on a pitched roof or finished high-quality roof in the foreground. Suburban US home in the background with trees and clear sky.
golden_hour_warm.skyDescriptor: Golden hour sky transitioning from blue to warm orange near the horizon.
golden_hour_warm.shadowDescriptor: Long warm shadows from low-angle sun. Soft and directional.

overcast_calm.lightingBrief: Soft, even overcast light. No harsh shadows. Colors are natural and slightly muted. A roofing crew working methodically on a residential roof. The scene reads as professional and calm, not urgent.
overcast_calm.skyDescriptor: Light overcast, white to light grey sky. Bright enough to be workable.
overcast_calm.shadowDescriptor: Minimal shadow definition. Soft and even.

dramatic_dusk.lightingBrief: Early dusk with warm-to-cool transition in the sky. A crew finishing a job or a completed roof silhouetted against a dramatic sky. The mood communicates reliability, the work is done even as day ends.
dramatic_dusk.skyDescriptor: Dramatic dusk sky, warm orange near horizon transitioning to deep blue-purple above. High clouds catching the last light.
dramatic_dusk.shadowDescriptor: Long dark shadows. Subject in partial silhouette. Strong contrast.

bright_midday_clean.lightingBrief: Bright midday sun, high and direct. Clean clear colors, no warm tones. A crew on a roof working confidently. The scene looks clinical and precise, good for conveying accuracy and technical work.
bright_midday_clean.skyDescriptor: Deep blue clear sky at midday. No clouds.
bright_midday_clean.shadowDescriptor: Short direct shadows directly below objects. High contrast.

dawn_soft_optimistic.lightingBrief: Early morning soft pink and golden light. A crew arriving and setting up. The mood communicates punctuality, fresh start, the job starting on time as promised.
dawn_soft_optimistic.skyDescriptor: Early dawn sky, soft pinks and light blues. Sun just above or below the horizon.
dawn_soft_optimistic.shadowDescriptor: Very soft long shadows from low dawn light. Gentle and warm.
